name: @pipeworx/mcp-microlink

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Extract metadata from any URL to preview page content. Returns title, description, image, author, publisher, logo, and structured data—useful when you need to understand a webpage without visiting it directly.

url.description: The URL to extract metadata from.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of any webpage. Returns image URL showing the rendered page layout and visual content—use to verify page state or design.

url.description: The URL of the webpage to screenshot.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-microlink forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the microlink pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
